inputs.modified_text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden did the right thing by signing Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, which now requires new registered voters to prove they are United States citizens before casting ballots in state elections. This restores the basic order our republic depends on, making sure only those with a legitimate stake in America get to shape its future. Progressive institutions have spent years trying to weaken citizenship standards and erode national sovereignty in the name of inclusion, but leaders like Rhoden are pushing back with the authority and tradition that built this country. It reinforces personal responsibility by treating the vote as a serious duty reserved for Americans, not outsiders, and protects the cultural continuity that keeps our society stable and focused on the families and communities who sustain it.
